natural: treat the people as if they were wounded

meaning.en: To treat the people with tender care, as though they were injured; the mark of a benevolent ruler.
meaning.zh: 把百姓看作受了伤的人那样爱护，形容统治者仁爱。

equivalents: treat the people as one's own

examples.zh: 好官应当视民如伤，而不是盘剥百姓。
examples.en: A good official should treat the people with care rather than exploit them.

examples.zh: 史书称赞这位县令视民如伤。
examples.en: The histories praise this magistrate for caring for his people like wounded kin.

story.en: The Zuo Commentary says of the King of Wu: 'He regards the people as if wounded; this is his good fortune' (视民如伤，是其福也).
story.zh: 《左传·哀公元年》：“视民如伤，是其福也。”

usage.en: Used in praise of upright officials; formal or literary.
usage.zh: 称赞清官好官，较正式或书面。

text: 一母生九子，连母十个样
pinyin: yī mǔ shēng jiǔ zǐ, lián mǔ shí gè yàng
literal: one · mother · bear · nine · sons, with · mother · ten · kinds
natural: nine sons of one mother, ten different kinds counting the mother

meaning.en: Even children of one mother differ from one another.
meaning.zh: 同一个母亲生的孩子，性格相貌也各不相同。

equivalents: five fingers are not all the same

examples.zh: 一母生九子，连母十个样，兄弟俩性格完全不同。
examples.en: Even children of one mother differ; the two brothers have quite different characters.

examples.zh: 别拿弟弟和哥哥比，一母生九子，连母十个样。
examples.en: Don't compare him with his brother; even children of one mother turn out different.

usage.en: Often used to excuse differences among siblings.
usage.zh: 常用来说明兄弟姐妹之间各有不同。

pinyin: ǎi zi lǐ bá jiāng jūn
literal: short people · among · pull out · general
natural: pick a general from among the short

meaning.en: To choose the best of a mediocre bunch when no truly outstanding candidates exist.
meaning.zh: 在平庸的人当中挑选相对较好的。

equivalents: the best of a bad bunch
the pick of the litter among the mediocre

examples.zh: 队里没有高手，只能矮子里拔将军。
examples.en: The team has no stars, so we have to pick the best of a modest lot.

examples.zh: 这次选举其实是矮子里拔将军。
examples.en: This election was really the best of a poor bunch.

usage.en: Colloquial; mildly self-mocking, and the word 矮子 here is a figure of speech.
usage.zh: 口语，略带自嘲；“矮子”只是比喻。

synonyms: 蜀中无大将，廖化作先锋

natural: fierce generals thick as clouds

meaning.en: A great many brave and capable generals; more broadly, a team full of talent.
meaning.zh: 勇猛的将领极多，也比喻人才济济。

examples.zh: 蜀汉后期已非猛将如云的时代。
examples.en: Late Shu Han was no longer an age with generals thick as clouds.

examples.zh: 这支球队猛将如云，夺冠呼声很高。
examples.en: The team is full of stars and is tipped to take the title.

usage.en: Often paired with 谋臣如雨.
usage.zh: 常与“谋臣如雨”连用。

antonyms: 蜀中无大将，廖化作先锋

natural: don't comment on what is already done

meaning.en: Do not dwell on or criticise what has already been done.
meaning.zh: 已经做成的事，不必再议论评说。

equivalents: no use crying over spilt milk

examples.zh: 成事不说，大家向前看吧。
examples.en: What's done is done; let's look ahead.

examples.zh: 孔子说成事不说，遂事不谏，既往不咎。
examples.en: Confucius said: no comment on what is done, no remonstrating over what is over, no blame for the past.

story.en: Confucius answered Zai Wo on the altar of the earth: 'What is done is not discussed, what is over is not remonstrated, what is past is not blamed' (成事不说，遂事不谏，既往不咎).
story.zh: 《论语·八佾》：“成事不说，遂事不谏，既往不咎。”

usage.en: Quoted from the Analects with the next lines 遂事不谏，既往不咎. Note it differs from 成事不足，败事有余.
usage.zh: 出自《论语》，后接“遂事不谏，既往不咎”；与“成事不足，败事有余”意思不同。

pinyin: ài zhī shēn, zé zhī qiè
literal: love · it · deep, blame · it · keen
natural: the deeper the love, the sharper the rebuke

meaning.en: The more one loves someone, the more strictly one criticises them.
meaning.zh: 爱得越深，要求和责备也越严厉。

examples.zh: 爱之深，责之切，老师其实是为你好。
examples.en: Strict because of deep care; the teacher really means well.

examples.zh: 父亲对他爱之深，责之切。
examples.en: His father loved him deeply and so judged him sharply.

usage.en: Often said to console someone who has been scolded, or to justify strictness.
usage.zh: 常用于安慰被责备的人，或为严格要求作解释。

natural: dote blindly

meaning.en: To spoil someone out of blind affection, unable to see their faults.
meaning.zh: 因过分宠爱而看不清是非，纵容错误。

examples.zh: 父母溺爱不明，孩子难免任性。
examples.en: Parents who dote blindly will find their child wilful.

examples.zh: 对下属溺爱不明，只会纵容错误。
examples.en: Doting on subordinates without judgement only encourages mistakes.

usage.en: Typical in discussions of parenting; usually critical.
usage.zh: 多见于谈论家教，含批评。

text: 女儿是爸爸的贴心小棉袄
pinyin: nǚ ér shì bà ba de tiē xīn xiǎo mián ǎo
literal: daughter · is · dad · 's · close-to-heart · little · padded jacket
natural: a daughter is her dad's warm little padded jacket

meaning.en: A daughter is her father's close and comforting companion.
meaning.zh: 女儿对父亲体贴关心，像贴身的小棉袄一样温暖。

equivalents: a daughter is a father's comfort

examples.zh: 人们常说女儿是爸爸的贴心小棉袄，他深有体会。
examples.en: People say a daughter is her dad's warm little padded jacket, and he feels it deeply.

examples.zh: 女儿是爸爸的贴心小棉袄，她每天给他送汤。
examples.en: A daughter is a father's cosy little jacket, and she brings him soup every day.

usage.en: A modern affectionate saying, often contrasted with 嫁出去的女儿，泼出去的水. The mother-daughter version is 小棉袄.
usage.zh: 现代亲昵俗语，常与旧话“嫁出去的女儿，泼出去的水”对照。

antonyms: 嫁出去的女儿，泼出去的水

natural: offer the labour of a dog or horse

meaning.en: A humble offer to serve someone loyally.
meaning.zh: 谦称愿为对方尽力效劳。

examples.zh: 只要您吩咐，我愿效犬马之劳。
examples.en: Whatever you command, I am glad to serve.

examples.zh: 为了公司发展，他愿效犬马之劳。
examples.en: For the sake of the firm he is willing to work like a faithful horse.

usage.en: Self-humbling and formal; can sound servile or humorous in modern speech.
usage.zh: 自谦用语，较正式，今天听来可能显得卑微或带诙谐。

natural: nine bends and eighteen turns

meaning.en: Winding and twisting many times; a river, road or process full of turns.
meaning.zh: 弯弯曲曲、转折极多，形容河流、道路或事情曲折。

examples.zh: 山路九曲十八弯，开车要小心。
examples.en: The mountain road has bend after bend; drive carefully.

examples.zh: 这件事九曲十八弯，一时说不清。
examples.en: The affair has so many twists it can't be explained quickly.

usage.en: Colloquial; numbers show 'many', not an exact count.
usage.zh: 口语，数字表示“很多”，并非实数。

natural: a regional lord

meaning.en: A local ruler who holds power over a region; today, a head of a big region or company with real autonomy.
meaning.zh: 镇守一方的诸侯，今指执掌一地或一个部门大权的人。

examples.zh: 他坐镇一方，俨然一方诸侯。
examples.en: Stationed in the region, he was virtually its lord.

examples.zh: 分公司总经理几乎是一方诸侯。
examples.en: A branch general manager is almost a regional baron.

usage.en: Historical, often used in office-politics jokes.
usage.zh: 历史用语，今多用于职场调侃。

natural: the disciple of the closing door

meaning.en: A master's last pupil, accepted before he stops taking students.
meaning.zh: 老师最后收的、不再另收的学生。

examples.zh: 他是这位大师的关门弟子。
examples.en: He is the last pupil that master accepted.

examples.zh: 老先生收下关门弟子后，便不再授徒。
examples.en: After taking his final disciple, the old man stopped teaching.

usage.en: Often implies the master's special attention; 入室弟子 is a different term meaning a trusted inner student.
usage.zh: 常含老师格外器重之意；“入室弟子”则指亲传高徒，不同。

natural: investigated: no such matter

meaning.en: A formal denial: after checking, there is no such thing.
meaning.zh: 经过调查，没有这件事。

examples.zh: 有关部门回应：经核查，查无此事。
examples.en: The authorities replied that there is no record of such a matter.

examples.zh: 网上的传闻经核实，查无此事。
examples.en: After checking, the online rumour proved groundless.

usage.en: Official style; sometimes used ironically when a denial is not believed.
usage.zh: 公文语气，有时也用于讽刺不可信的否认。

natural: one arrow hits the mark

meaning.en: To hit the target in one shot; to succeed first time or hit the point exactly.
meaning.zh: 一箭射中靶心，比喻一次成功或说话切中要害。

examples.zh: 他的一番话一箭中的，说到了问题的关键。
examples.en: His remarks hit the bullseye and touched the crux of the problem.

examples.zh: 设计方案一箭中的，客户当场拍板。
examples.en: The design hit the mark and the client approved on the spot.

usage.en: Predicate; both literal archery and figurative use.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，可指射箭，也可作比喻。

literal: can · gaze at · not · can · reach
natural: can be seen but not reached

meaning.en: Visible but out of reach; something desirable that cannot be attained.
meaning.zh: 看得见却够不着，指想要的东西无法得到。

equivalents: so near and yet so far

examples.zh: 那个目标对他而言可望不可即。
examples.en: That goal seemed visible but out of his reach.

examples.zh: 名校对许多孩子来说可望不可即。
examples.en: A top university is something many children can only dream of.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive; often about dreams or inaccessible people.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、定语，常指梦想或遥不可及的人。

natural: have a couple of moves

meaning.en: To have real ability; to be good at something.
meaning.zh: 有本事，有点真功夫。

examples.zh: 别小看他，他还真有两下子。
examples.en: Don't underestimate him; he really has what it takes.

examples.zh: 这位新来的厨师有两下子。
examples.en: The new chef knows his stuff.

usage.en: Colloquial; mostly a modest compliment, as 有两把刷子.
usage.zh: 口语，多为带点惊讶的夸奖，类似“有两把刷子”。

synonyms: 油漆匠的家当——有两把刷子

natural: half a bottle of vinegar

meaning.en: Someone with only half-baked knowledge who likes to show it off.
meaning.zh: 略懂皮毛却爱到处卖弄的人。

equivalents: a little learning is a dangerous thing

examples.zh: 他是半瓶子醋，却老爱指点别人。
examples.en: He is a half-baked dabbler yet always likes to instruct others.

examples.zh: 我这半瓶子醋，就别在专家面前献丑了。
examples.en: I only have a smattering of knowledge, so let me not embarrass myself before the experts.

usage.en: Colloquial; critical of others, humble when said of oneself. A half-full bottle sloshes, so it makes noise.
usage.zh: 口语，说别人含贬义，自谦时则是谦辞；半瓶醋晃荡作响，比喻爱炫耀。

antonyms: 油漆匠的家当——有两把刷子

natural: cannot stand firm

meaning.en: Untenable; an argument, reason or position that cannot hold up.
meaning.zh: 理由、论点或立场不能成立，经不起检验。

examples.zh: 这个借口根本站不住脚。
examples.en: That excuse simply doesn't hold water.

examples.zh: 他的理论在事实面前站不住脚。
examples.en: His theory is untenable in the face of the facts.

usage.en: Often used with 理由、论据、说法. Can also mean someone cannot stay somewhere.
usage.zh: 常与“理由、论据、说法”搭配；也可指在某处待不下去。

natural: fate was stingy even with one meeting

meaning.en: To miss meeting someone by ill luck, never being granted even one meeting.
meaning.zh: 缘分浅薄，连见一面的机会也没有。

examples.zh: 听说大师来过，我却缘悭一面。
examples.en: I heard the master had visited, but I was not fated to meet him.

examples.zh: 崇拜多年的作家去世了，真是缘悭一面。
examples.en: The author I admired for years has died; we were never fated to meet.

usage.en: A polite literary regret, often about a famous person.
usage.zh: 含惋惜意味的书面语，多指未能见到名人。

natural: harms good taste

meaning.en: Offensive to good taste or propriety; slightly improper.
meaning.zh: 有损文雅，不合体面或格调。

examples.zh: 在正式场合大声喧哗，实在有伤大雅。
examples.en: Shouting in a formal setting is really in poor taste.

examples.zh: 这个玩笑有伤大雅，别再说了。
examples.en: The joke is a bit improper; don't tell it again.

usage.en: Typically 无伤大雅 (does no real harm) is the opposite; 有伤大雅 is a mild rebuke.
usage.zh: 常见反义说法是“无伤大雅”；“有伤大雅”是较温和的批评。

natural: what kind of decorum is this

meaning.en: What a disgrace; used to rebuke behaviour that is improper.
meaning.zh: 这成什么样子，用于责备不合规矩的行为。

examples.zh: 大庭广众之下吵架，成何体统！
examples.en: Quarrelling in public view, what a disgrace!

examples.zh: 衣冠不整就来开会，成何体统？
examples.en: Coming to the meeting scruffily dressed, how improper!

usage.en: A rhetorical question; stern and a bit old-fashioned, often heard in costume dramas.
usage.zh: 反问句，语气严厉，略显旧式，常见于古装剧。

natural: half refusing, half welcoming

meaning.en: Pretending to refuse while actually welcoming; feigned reluctance.
meaning.zh: 嘴上想拒绝，实际却又迎合，形容假装推辞。

examples.zh: 她欲拒还迎的态度让他摸不透。
examples.en: Her coy, half-refusing manner baffled him.

examples.zh: 他推辞了几句，不过是欲拒还迎罢了。
examples.en: His refusals were just for show.

usage.en: Used for romance or for polite show-refusals; can imply insincerity.
usage.zh: 可用于感情，也可用于客套推辞；含不够真诚之意。

natural: as close as one family

meaning.en: Very close to one another, like members of the same family.
meaning.zh: 关系亲密得像一家人。

examples.zh: 两家住对门多年，亲如一家。
examples.en: The two families have lived opposite for years, as close as kin.

examples.zh: 同学们相处得亲如一家。
examples.en: The classmates get along like one family.

usage.en: Positive; often used of neighbours, teams and peoples.
usage.zh: 褒义，常用于邻里、团队、民族。

natural: probe the profound, seek the hidden

meaning.en: To investigate deep and obscure matters and uncover their hidden meaning.
meaning.zh: 探究深奥的道理，寻找隐秘的内容。

examples.zh: 学者探赜索隐，终于解读出这段铭文。
examples.en: The scholars probed deeply and finally decoded the inscription.

examples.zh: 他读书喜欢探赜索隐。
examples.en: He likes to probe the obscure when he reads.

story.en: The Book of Changes: 'To probe the profound and seek the hidden, hook the deep and reach the far' (探赜索隐，钩深致远).
story.zh: 《周易·系辞上》：“探赜索隐，钩深致远，以定天下之吉凶。”

date.zh: 战国 · 约前4—前3世纪（《易传》）
date.en: Warring States, c. 4th–3rd c. BC (Yi Zhuan commentaries)

usage.en: Literary, scholarly register.
usage.zh: 书面语，多用于学术。
